mapper.sql: id, order_no, source_appeal_id, title, content, category, sub_category, level, attention_count, confidence, hit_keywords, need_review, region, county_code, county_name, department, street_office, dept_receive_time, street_receive_time, street_code, street_name, address_detail, is_broad, status, same_source_order_id, event_type, dispose_plan, dispose_result, dispose_tag, dispose_time, dispose_user_id, dispose_user_name, deadline, is_overdue, delay_count, street_return_count, dept_return_count, dept_audit_status, dept_audit_time, dept_audit_user_id, dept_audit_user_name, dept_audit_remark, dept_score, dept_score_time, final_audit_status, final_audit_time, final_audit_user_id, final_audit_user_name, final_audit_remark, final_reject_target, archive_time, archive_type, is_archived, reopen_count, close_time, is_completed, is_deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM street_work_order WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO street_work_order SELECT * FROM admin_work_order WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, title, content, category, sub_category, level, region, department, street_office, status, is_overdue, deadline, create_time, update_time, dispose_tag, dept_audit_status, final_audit_status, hit_keywords, confidence, dept_receive_time, street_receive_time FROM street_work_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND street_office LIKE CONCAT(#{streetOffice}, '%') AND status NOT IN ('PENDING_DISPATCH', 'PENDING_REASSIGN', 'PENDING_DEPT_PROCESS', 'PENDING_DEPT_ASSIGN', 'PENDING_EVALUATE', 'EVALUATED', 'STREET_DONE', 'STREET_REJECTED', 'DEPT_AUDITED', 'DEPT_REJECTED', 'CLOSED', 'ARCHIVED', 'RETURNED') AND order_no = #{orderNo} AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND status = #{status} AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING_STREET_PROCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_handle, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING_DEPT_PROCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_verify, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING_DEPT_ASSIGN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_assign, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING_EVALUATE', 'EVALUATED', 'STREET_DONE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_audit, SUM(CASE WHEN year(dispose_time) = #{year} AND month(dispose_time) = #{month} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS month_done, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN dept_score IS NOT NULL THEN dept_score END), 0) AS avg_score FROM street_work_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND street_office = #{region}
